stratum.purpose: Whole-solution over-engineering and requirement-justified near-miss cases for the self-sufficient solution-simplicity lens. No executable oracle exists for this subject - 'over-engineered' and 'requirement-justified' are design judgements a runnable check cannot decide - so every case's second adjudication is `owner_confirmed`: the owner adjudicated all four directly, confirming every recommended disposition with no overturns. SCORED: both owner-gated inputs are satisfied, and every expectation stays `calibrated: false` permanently, per the owner-settled three-way grading method.
